preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m must be between 2 and 300.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in initial_state) and all(len(row) == m for row in final_state)
preconditions.description: Each row in the initial and final states must contain exactly m strings.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(cell) for row in initial_state for cell in row) == sum(len(cell) for row in final_state for cell in row) <= 100000
preconditions.description: The total length of strings in the initial and final states must be equal and not exceed 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'0', '1'} for row in initial_state for cell in row) and all(cell in {'0', '1'} for row in final_state for cell in row)
preconditions.description: All characters in the strings of the initial and final states must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The number of operations q must be between 0 and 4 times the total length of strings s.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= m and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= m for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: All coordinates in the operations must be within the bounds of the table.

postconditions.expression: all((x1, y1) != (x2, y2) and (x1 == x2 or y1 == y2) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must involve two different cells in the same row or column.
The final state of the table must match the specified final state after all operations.
